ACTION_5.implementation: Marks the workflow as complete after the intake worker reviews the assigned application.

steps.label: Assign to Intake Worker
steps.description: System automatically assigns the submitted application to an available intake worker based on predefined site and staffing allocation rules. The assignment logic ensures load balancing, prioritizes staff availability, and considers the application channel (Online Portal, In-Person Site, or Mobile Unit). The system updates the application status to 'Assigned to Intake Worker' and records the assigned worker's ID for audit purposes.

assignments.label: Assign to Intake Worker
assignments.logic: Upon application submission, the system evaluates the applicant's selected site and application channel, retrieves current intake worker availability per staffing rules, and assigns the application to the next available intake worker at the appropriate site. The assignment is logged, and the application status is updated accordingly.

ACTION_6.name: Return to Application Channel Selection
ACTION_6.implementation: Navigates back to the Application Channel Selection screen.

fields.label: Disaster-Related Expenses

steps.label: Intake Worker Task: Review Assigned Application
steps.description: Intake worker reviews the assigned application, verifies completeness of submitted information and documentation, and begins initial processing. The system routes the application to the intake worker based on site and staffing rules. The intake worker must confirm receipt, check for missing or inconsistent data, and prepare for applicant interview and eligibility review.

completionConditions.logic: Intake worker must confirm application receipt, review all submitted data and documentation for completeness and accuracy, flag any missing or questionable information, and mark the application as 'Reviewed' in the system.

steps.label: Select Application Channel
steps.description: On this screen, you will choose how you wish to apply for D-SNAP benefits. Please select your preferred application channel: Online Portal, In-Person Site, or Mobile Unit. Guidance is provided to help you understand each option. Your selection will determine the next steps in your application process.

rules.label: Conduct Interview

rules.label: Record Interview Notes
rules.logic: Intake worker enters interview notes and any clarifications or discrepancies into the system for audit and eligibility determination.

rules.label: Identity Verification

rules.label: Residency Verification

steps.label: Review Application and Documentation

rules.label: Intake Worker Confirmation

steps.label: Assign to Certification Worker
steps.description: System routes the reviewed application record to a certification worker, ensuring that the assigned certification worker is not the same as the intake worker who previously handled the application. The assignment logic enforces separation of duties, checks certification worker availability, and updates the application status to 'Assigned to Certification Worker'. The system logs the assignment for audit and compliance tracking.

assignments.label: Assign to Certification Worker
assignments.logic: After intake review is complete, the system selects a certification worker who is available and not the same as the intake worker assigned to the application. The application is routed to this worker, the assignment is recorded, and the status is updated to reflect the new assignment.

steps.label: Duplicate Participation Check
steps.description: On this screen, you will run a duplicate participation check to ensure the applicant is not receiving benefits from multiple programs. The system searches for matches and flags any potential duplicates. Guidance is provided for interpreting the results.
data_validation: Duplicate check must be run before proceeding
Potential matches must be reviewed

buttons.label: Review Duplicate Results
buttons.description: Review duplicate participation results

steps.label: Certification Worker Task: Certify and Approve D-SNAP Benefits
steps.description: Certification worker reviews the assigned record, verifies that all intake steps are complete, confirms separation of duties, and prepares to certify and approve D-SNAP benefits. The system routes the record to the certification worker after intake review. The certification worker must validate eligibility determination, ensure all documentation is present, and approve or deny benefits as appropriate.

completionConditions.logic: Certification worker must review all intake data and documentation, confirm eligibility determination, ensure separation of duties, and click 'Approve Benefits' or 'Deny Benefits' in the system. Task is complete when benefits are approved/denied and system records the action.

steps.label: Duplicate Participation Decision
steps.description: On this screen, you will review the results of the duplicate participation check. The system displays any flagged matches for your review. You can confirm or request further investigation. Guidance is provided for making a decision.
data_validation: If duplicate participation is confirmed, notes must be entered

buttons.label: Assign to Certification Worker

steps.label: Certify and Approve D-SNAP Benefits
steps.description: Certification worker reviews all application data, confirms separation of duties, and clicks the 'Approve Benefits' button to certify and approve D-SNAP benefits.

rules.label: Review Application Data

rules.label: Confirm Separation of Duties
rules.logic: Certification worker verifies that intake and certification roles are performed by different individuals.

rules.label: Approve Benefits
